scientific_integrity: A complete written proof and standalone finite consistency checker are provided. No independent mathematical audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: General exact PL correspondence is proved for all finite simple base graphs, but the explicit skeleton homotopy type uses bipartiteness. The equality case of Smith inequality uses the published two-row grid ambient homotopy theorem; the theorem does not classify general nonbipartite fixed-space homotopy or equivariant homology modules. Unindexed equivalent results cannot be excluded.
title: Layer-exchange fixed spaces of robust clique complexes of graph prisms
